name: Service overview (OTel)
description: Requests, errors and latency from spans plus error logs of one service.

panels.title: Requests
panels.query: source spans | service:$service and kind:server | stats count() by service span auto

panels.title: Errored spans
panels.query: source spans | service:$service and status:error | stats count() by service span auto

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.query: source spans | service:$service and kind:server | stats p95(duration) by service span auto

panels.title: Error logs
panels.query: service:$service and level >= error | stats count()

panels.title: Slowest operations
panels.query: source spans | service:$service | stats p95(duration), count() by name | sort p95_duration desc | limit 20
